meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把画好的流程图(多智能体 DAG)存成文件,以后按名字直接重跑;每次运行自动加时间戳,同名的多次运行不会互相覆盖。
howto.when: 当你说要保存某个 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或想反复调度同一个多智能体图谱时触发。

say.text: 把刚才这个图存成 nightly-audit,然后跑一次
say.note: 会存到默认库目录,预览执行一次确认没问题。

say.text: 运行我昨天保存的 weekly-report
say.note: 按名字载入定义并启动,自动生成新时间戳为新一次运行。

howto.what_en: Stores a multi-agent DAG definition as a file and re-runs it by name. Each run gets an automatic timestamp so repeated runs never overwrite each other.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or repeatedly schedule the same multi-agent graph.

say_en.text: Save this graph as nightly-audit and run it once.
say_en.note: Saves to the default library dir and previews by executing it once.

say_en.text: Run the weekly-report I saved yesterday.
say_en.note: Loads the definition by name and starts it with a fresh timestamp.
